title: Robust Lightweight IoT Device Fingerprinting Under Network Traffic Anomalies
abstract: arXiv:2610.27351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate IoT device identification is essential for network security, yet many existing approaches rely on payload inspection, feature engineering, or long observation windows that limit scalability and often assume stable network conditions despite the inherent variability of real-world IoT traffic. We propose a lightweight IoT device identification approach based on packet headers and locality-sensitive hashing (LSH), generating compact fingerprint representations at packet- and window-level granularities. To evaluate robustness, we consider packet-level traffic anomalies including drop, perturbation, reordering, duplication, and packet injection. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves up to 99% accuracy while maintaining robustness under realistic traffic distortions using short bounded observation windows. translated_title: 网络流量异常下鲁棒的轻量级物联网设备指纹识别
translated_abstract: 准确的物联网设备识别对网络安全至关重要，然而许多现有方法依赖载荷检测、特征工程或较长的观测窗口，这限制了可扩展性，并且尽管真实物联网流量本身具有固有变异性，这些方法通常假设网络状况稳定。我们提出一种基于数据包头与局部敏感哈希（LSH）的轻量级物联网设备识别方法，在数据包级和窗口级粒度上生成紧凑的指纹表示。为评估鲁棒性，我们考虑了包括丢包、扰动、乱序、重复以及数据包注入在内的数据包级流量异常。实验结果表明，该方法在使用短而有界的观测窗口的情况下，在真实流量失真下仍保持鲁棒性，准确率最高可达99%。影响全局流量结构的异常会造成最大的性能下降，而窗口……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于数据包头和局部敏感哈希的轻量级物联网设备指纹识别方法，在使用短观测窗口并遭受丢包、扰动、注入等多种流量异常时，仍能实现高达99%的识别准确率并保持鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight IoT device fingerprinting approach based on packet headers and locality-sensitive hashing that achieves up to 99% accuracy while remaining robust under realistic traffic anomalies such as drops, perturbations, reordering, duplication, and injection, even with short bounded observation windows.
